dct_description_sm: In 2015, MPWA completed a Watershed Restoration Plan for the Redwillow Watershed and has both completed some recommendations identified in the plan as well as engaged with other organizations and encouraged them to implement these recommendations. In order to understand current condition of the watershed as well to assess the effectiveness of restoration efforts, MPWA has undertaken follow-up monitoring including summer water temperature monitoring. This monitoring was completed by deploying Hobo temperature loggers at various locations throughout the Redwillow Watershed.
